events.title: Try the Hearts Extreme demo this weekend
events.summary: Steam Next Fest is underway. If you haven't tried Hearts Extreme yet, the free demo is available this weekend. It includes the Base Deck and Magic Deck. If you've only played the Base Deck, try switching to the Magic Deck to see how its special cards change the game. Both decks include levels 1–10 in 4-player mode. For the full game, we're also working on in-game events with different challenges every two weeks and cosmetic rewards for completing them. We'll share the details when they're ready.

events.title: Hearts Extreme is in Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Hearts Extreme is taking part in Steam Next Fest. It's a single-player card puzzle where everyone's hand is visible. Each level gives you a goal to work toward with the cards on the table. You don't need to know Hearts to start; the game introduces the rules as you play. The demo includes levels 1–10 of both the Base Deck and Magic Deck in 4-player mode. It's available on Windows and macOS. events.title: Playtest access has gone out — check your Steam library
events.summary: If you requested access to the Hearts Extreme Playtest, you have it now. Look for Hearts Extreme Playtest in your Steam library and hit install — it's about 112 MB.This is the full game, not a cut-down demo. All 10 decks, all 250 stages, the 4/5/6-player modes, and the Daily Challenge are open from the start.
